why_chosen: Singapore-founded last-mile logistics company with large Singapore hub and warehouse operations, plausible for an operations or warehouse supervisor job seeker; chosen before research.

identity.summary: Registered as Ninja Logistics Pte. Ltd., UEN 201412014E, incorporated 25 Apr 2014, Live, auditor Deloitte; founded by Lai Chang Wen, Shaun Chong, Tan Boxian.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced registry aggregators and the extract returned the ACRA-derived record cleanly.
identity.what_was_missing: Registry page address and date fields were stale or garbled; no official ACRA source.

business_and_headcount.summary: Last-mile courier in six countries; headcount claims conflict (about 3,000 vs 1,001-5,000 vs 65,000 claimed, likely incl. contractors); no Singapore-only figure.
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Found profile and headcount aggregator pages quickly.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: Reliable Singapore headcount; aggregator figures are estimates seen in snippets.

financial_performance.summary: FY2025 revenue down 3% to US$702m, losses narrowed 31%; FY2024 revenue down about 8%; last equity round Sep 2021 (US$578m); US$50m debt Oct 2024; no IPO date.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Search snippets from Tech in Asia gave the key numbers.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: Full articles unreadable (JS wall); absolute loss figures and profit timeline not obtained.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: Three rounds: Apr 2024 regional tech, Jul 2024 about 5% Singapore, Aug 2025 about 12% Singapore; severance per tripartite advisory; company not unionised.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: One search returned multiple major outlets; the CNA extract was full and clean.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Absolute headcounts affected and whether warehouse roles were hit.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Glassdoor 3.5 global and 3.2 Singapore, WLB 3.6 (snippets); recurring themes of peak-time burnout, KPI pressure, long hours; the one readable review summary appears regional (mentions BPJS).
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Snippets gave ratings and themes; the Jobstreet extract returned an AI summary.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Glassdoor extract failed, Indeed reviews not extracted, no actual review text; Singapore-specific supervisor views missing.

pay_and_benefits.summary: One expired ad S$2,600-3,900/month for warehouse coordinator/supervisor/team leader; Glassdoor average about S$3,204 from 7 submissions (snippet); no benefits list.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Search directly found a relevant job ad with range and the extract read it fully.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Indeed hit a cookie wall; benefits, overtime policy and current salary data.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Glassdoor snippets say interviews are straightforward; an internship guide says 1-2 rounds; nothing supervisor-specific.
interview_and_hiring.how_openserp_helped: Search returned interview pages and the official careers page.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Page content of any interview page; ops-role process.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No scam, legal or regulatory findings; the targeted searches returned irrelevant results so absence is weak evidence. Operational red flag: May 2026 delivery delays.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: Any dedicated check of regulatory or court records; OR-style queries performed poorly.

recent_news.summary: May 2026 delivery delays and apology; FY2025 results May 2026; Malaysia growth forecast Jan 2026.
recent_news.how_openserp_helped: A simple query gave dated, relevant news; the Mothership extract was clean.
recent_news.what_was_missing: Anything after May 2026; Tech in Asia articles unreadable.

most_useful_sources: search snippets from Glassdoor and Tech in Asia
misleading_or_wrong_results: Compound OR-style queries for legal/scam issues returned unrelated PDPC, court and foreign news pages
Jobstreet 'sg' review page content appeared to be Indonesian (mentions BPJS)
Glassdoor snippet gave warehouse supervisor salary as S$3,204 'per year'; unit is wrong
Registry page showed stale or garbled address and account dates

verdict.reasoning: OpenSERP was strong on news-driven facts (layoffs, results, delays) and found a directly relevant job ad. Plain-language queries worked well; compound OR queries did not. It is weak where employer-review sites are involved because those pages are blocked, JS-walled or cookie-walled, leaving only snippets. Culture, pay and interview evidence is therefore thin and needs checking elsewhere.
biggest_gaps: Real employee review text and Singapore-specific supervisor sentiment
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Speak to current or former Singapore hub staff
Written offer terms on overtime, shift pattern and notice
Ask directly about headcount plans and recent restructuring
Check MOM and court records for the employer directly
Read the full Glassdoor and Indeed reviews in a browser
